title: Parametric Gaussian band at nominal 90% covered 84.2%
severity_reason: nominal outside the coverage interval, and misses run 1.36x more frequent in the most expensive intervals (interval lower bound 1.14 > 1)
measurement: Headline 90%: coverage 0.842, day-block bootstrap 95% interval [0.815, 0.867] over 32,252 scored intervals. Every audited level: 80%: covered 74.4% [71.3%, 77.4%], concentration 1.29x [1.13, 1.47], Material; 90%: covered 84.2% [81.5%, 86.7%], concentration 1.36x [1.14, 1.61], Material; 95%: covered 89.6% [87.3%, 91.9%], concentration 1.43x [1.14, 1.75], Material
evidence: coverage.json, findings.csv; Fig. Coverage ladder, Fig. Concentration
consequence: EUR 362,495 of un-reserved adverse exposure per 100 MW mean load over the audited period at the 90% level
action: Re-state the band at its measured coverage, or recalibrate. The adaptive construction audited here is one option and its width cost is quantified.
limit: Measured on this series over this period only. The interval is block-bootstrapped by day and so already carries within-day dependence; it does not carry uncertainty in the price series.
